subject: POC Onboarding & Integration Next Steps — Aperture Labs
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@aperturelabs.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@aperturelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-16T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC Onboarding & Integration Next Steps — Aperture Labs

Hi Elena & Samir,

Thanks again for taking the call today — good alignment across product and infra. I wanted to capture the immediate next steps so we can move the POC into an accelerated technical onboarding window. Below is a concise roadmap and owners list so everyone has a single source of truth.

Quick recap / objective:
- POC objective: validate Redwood inference for Aperture's customer support triage pipeline (intent classification + slot extraction) at production-like scale.
- Success criteria (agreed):
  - Integration correctness: endpoint returns structured intent + slots matching Aperture test set >= 92% F1 on intents, 85% on slots (per your labeled eval).
  - Performance: P95 latency <= 200ms for text generation paths under trial traffic profile (~20 req/s burst).
  - Cost guardrail: steady-state inference cost target <= $4 per 1k tokens (we'll provide profiling details).

Proposed 3-week runway (dates tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): Security touches & account prep — Aperture to share test account details, security point-of-contact, and SOC/infosec checklist items.
- Week 1: SDK integration and API route wiring — embed Redwood SDK in preprod and validate auth + basic inference calls (owner: Jonas).
- Week 2: Streaming & tool-calling flows — validate streaming responses for multi-turn chats and tool-calling hooks to Aperture's routing service (owner: Jonas + Aperture infra (Samir)).
- Week 3: Load validation & acceptance tests — run 48h soak and run the labeled eval suite; if success criteria met, proceed to acceptance sign-off.

Owners / points of contact:
- Redwood technical lead: Jonas Weber (jonas@redwood.com) — SDK/API routing, stream tests.
- Redwood sales & success: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com) — timeline and commercial questions.
- Aperture technical lead: Samir Khan (samir.k@aperturelabs.com) — infra, service accounts, routing.
- Aperture product: Elena Park (elena@aperturelabs.com) — success criteria, labeled eval.

Immediate asks for Aperture (can we get these by Monday?):
1) Short security contact + SOC 2 point-of-contact and an account for preprod testing (IAM/service account or temporary API key).
2) Access to a representative labeled eval set (CSV or Parquet) and a short doc that lists acceptance metric definitions.
3) Network allowlist IPs or any egress constraints so we can prepare firewall rules.

Attachments: I attached a compact POC scope doc and a draft SDK routing map (for Jonas to use).

If that matches your understanding I'll schedule the kickoff Monday 10am PT and loop in infra.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachment stubs: aperture-poc-scope.pdf (summary, 2pp); redwood-sdk-routing-map.md (routing + sample curl/snippets)
From: Elena Park <elena@aperturelabs.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@aperturelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Onboarding & Integration Next Steps — Aperture Labs

Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. This matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Acceptance metrics: we'll send the labeled eval set (sanitized) by Monday morning. Our intent labeler team will also include the CSV with column mapping and ground-truth fields.
- Security: our security lead Luke Chen (copied) will take the SOC 2 checklist; he asked whether Redwood provides an IP allowlist + TLS certificate fingerprint for the trial endpoints.
- Tech constraints: we will be doing the integration in a staging VPC so we'll need service account credentials or a short-lived API key for the Redwood staging environment.

One ask: can you confirm how streaming responses map to our tool-calling layer? We have a step in our flow that calls an internal enrichment service when certain slots are present — we'd like to test the tool-call trigger in Week 2.

Samir and I are available for the Monday kickoff; Samir will be the primary infra contact going forward.

Thanks,
Elena
Product Manager | Aperture Labs
elena@aperturelabs.com

Subject: Final prep before kickoff — integration checklist + short timeline

Elena / Samir / Luke —

Great — small update ahead of Monday's kickoff (10am PT). Below is the integration checklist Jonas will work through; if Aperture can confirm items 1–4 before the meeting we'll be able to start SDK work same day.

Integration checklist (confirm before kickoff):
1) Staging credentials: a service account email + role or a short-lived API key (owner: Aperture infra).
2) Labeled eval set location: Drive link or S3 bucket + access (owner: Aperture product).
3) Firewall rules: allowlist our staging IPs (we will provide them in the SDK routing map).
4) Tool-call endpoint: a POST endpoint for enrichment (sample URL + auth method).

Jonas — action items for kickoff / Week 1:
- Produce SDK quickstart branch + README (sample auth, sample intent/slot call).
- Add IPs and cert fingerprint to redwood-sdk-routing-map.md.
- Provide an example streaming client and server snippet showing incremental tokens + event for tool_call.

Marissa — action items for commercial / acceptance:
- Draft MAP and acceptance checklist; include trial length (3 weeks), a cost cap for the trial, and a simple rollback/fallback policy.

Elena / Samir — practical next steps for Aperture:
- Please share the service account and labeled eval by EOD Monday so Jonas can start wiring in the SDK.
- Luke: if you have the SOC contact or checklist questions in advance, share them and we'll route to security.

I'll run the kickoff invite and include a short agenda focused on the Week 1 deliverables. Thanks all — let's make this a smooth run.

Best,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
